d: Bihar bhajpa pradesh adhyaksh sanjay saravgi ne jan suraj ke sutradhar prashant kishor ke aaropon par palatvar karte hue kaha ki prashant kishor ko bihar ki rajniti ki chinta kam aur bhram phailane ki chinta jyada rahti hai. sanjay saravgi ne dava kiya ki bhajpa, jadyu aur endie ke panchon ghatak dalon ka gathbandhan puri tarah atut hai aur bihar men vikas, sushasan tatha jan vishvas ki majbut sajhedari hai. unhonne kaha ki koee bhi rajnitik bhavishyavakta is gathbandhan ko samapt nahin kar sakta aur vipaksh ya prashant kishor ki aisi bayanbaji keval unki hatasha ko darshati hai.
